scope: Supplement: saved small Peer/binding records plus history-01 only; no Gateway reread/native ledger
coverage_interpretation: 876 independent source rows, 876 distinct source hashes, and 876 unique capture pairs per flow in this saved cohort; not proof outside cohort or source publishing not recorded
old_receipt_bracket_basis: Guard receives/updates after Gateway destination entry and before TopicWire public publish; exact internal receipt is not stored

exact_observed_boundary_decomposition_ms.equation: R complete interval = source wrapper-before interval + new-path elapsed - old-path elapsed; not a guard internal timestamp

cadence_budget.meaning: Native credit stalls can defer next sim-timer generation. Source cadence and already-generated callback wait are separate; frozen rules unchanged.

unresolved: Exact raw publisher return and exact state generation instant are bracketed, not measured
Source interval numerical decomposition does not uniquely identify Native Run/IPC/DDS/scheduling cause
